account.readOnly: You can only view this account: its role is equal to or higher than yours.
account.notStarted: starts when the email is confirmed
account.lifetimeHint: Lifetime has no end date. The list price is {price} excl. VAT.
account.premiumHint: The months are added after the current period ends, if it is still running.
account.notePlaceholder: for example invoice or payment number
account.notifyOrder: The customer gets an email about the activation — the terms promise it.
account.linkedHint: Other accounts with the same device, the same HWID or the same IP address — a sign of a repeated trial or a shared account. Device and HWID link only accounts that consented to the fingerprint at sign-up; without consent only the IP address is left. Identical phones give the same HWID, and offices and mobile networks share addresses, so an HWID or IP shared by more than 10 accounts links nobody; a shared IP alone is no proof. How common an HWID is counts only among consenting accounts, so an HWID without a shared device or IP is a weak sign.
account.banHint: The person sees this reason when trying to sign in and gets it by email if their address is confirmed. Write clearly and without other people's personal data.
account.banConfirm: Block {email}? All the account's sessions will end.
account.revokeConfirm: End all sessions of {email}? The person will have to sign in again.
account.reset2faConfirm: Reset two-factor protection for {email}? The person will have to turn it on again.
account.roleConfirm: Change the role of {email}? The account's sessions will end.
account.roleHint: The team opens the admin panel only with two-factor protection.
account.ownerHint: Only an owner gives this role, after confirming with their password and code. An owner has every right, and nobody in the panel can take it back or act on their account — give it only to someone you entrust Korpora to. The action is recorded in the audit log.
account.ownerConfirm: Give {email} the “Owner” role? It cannot be undone from the panel.
account.deleteText: The account, projects, sessions and devices are deleted permanently. Orders stay with the contract details only (name, email, amount, dates, version of the accepted terms, early start and withdrawal) and are deleted {kept} after the account is deleted; an order awaiting payment is cancelled. Only a hash of the email stays in the audit log.
account.orderTerms: Buyer: {buyer}; early start: {early}; the paid period may start from {date} on.
account.openOrders: Open orders — a paid plan is activated through the order:
account.noPlanChanges: The plan has not been changed yet.
